name: Passive 3D TV / Projector
notes: Passive 3DTVs and projectors use polarised glasses and accept Side-by-Side or Top-and-Bottom at half resolution per eye. Some support frame-packed HDMI 3D for full resolution.

sbs.notes: Native side-by-side output for passive 3D TV.

tab.notes: Top-and-bottom output for passive TVs that support it.

frame_packing.notes: HDMI 3D frame-packed full resolution. Requires custom display resolution in Nvidia Control Panel.

anaglyph.notes: Anaglyph output for red/cyan glasses (or other color pairs via 3DToElse).

tab.notes: Enable tab_enable in VRto3D config, or use TaB output from fix directly.

interleaved.notes: 3DToElse ReShade shader converts SBS/TaB to row or column interlaced for interlaced passive displays.

vrto3d.notes: Standard SBS or TaB output. Set display_index to the 3DTV display number.

headtracking.notes: OpenTrack with any supported tracker (FaceTrackNoIR, ArUco, Wiimote, etc). Point output at game's supported input protocol.

setup_notes: Connect TV via HDMI. Set display_index in VRto3D default_config.json.
For interlaced output: install ReShade on vrserver.exe and enable 3DToElse shader. Set to Column Interlaced (SBS source) or Row Interlaced (TaB source).
For frame-packed HDMI 3D (full res): set tab_enable: true and framepack_offset in VRto3D config. Requires a custom resolution in Nvidia Control Panel.
